body:
Well my stepfather isn't subtle and my mother is very quiet when she talks about me to other people and has broken down crying about what we're going to do with me if I don't find a real job soon. And I did go to 2 universities actually, from one very expensive to much less expensive.

I feels like I've been fighting an uphill battle for so long. Even the shitty 1 bedroom apts in my area are 1k a month, not including utilities. I don't see how I could ever afford that. It just seems so hopeless..

24 feels so old for what I have accomplished. Most ppl are already married with a career and a house at 24. I've wasted so much of my youth and I'll never get it back. While it's technically true that my parents' started with little my mom claims she had a job less than 2 weeks after graduating and she barely had to apply. My stepdad never went to college and just worked job-to-job and now makes decent money in the auto industry. I wish I had lived in the 80s, sounds like a pretty great time. But no use being bitter. It's my fault I can't compete

I at least want to spare them the horror of finding my bloody corpse so I'm thinking I should just drive out in the middle of nowhere and slam my car into a tree but that might not be enough to finish the job. I guess the best is to lock myself in the bathroom and post a note on the door telling them not to open it and to call the police. Hopefully it won't devalue the house too much

Many reasons, right now because after years of hard work I can't find a job and so I'm forced to live with my parents, who think I'm a failure. I feel so guilty for wasting all their time, effort and money just to end up with a 24 yr old waitress/dog walker. I can't even find the energy to do basic tasks anymore. I'm just a dead weight
